data.name: Chinmayi
data.gender_notes: Chinmayi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Chin = Consciousness, Maya = Illusion, Vi = Divine. The name Chinmayi signifies one who has attained consciousness of the divine. It is a name that evokes a sense of spiritual awareness and connection with the divine. The name Chinmayi carries the meaning “Consciousness of the divine” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chinmayi usually hope their child will grow to embody consciousness of the divine and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Chinmayi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Consciousness of the divine.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chinmayi total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

The name Chinmayi reflects this goal by symbolizing one who has transcended the illusion of the material world and attained a deep understanding of the divine consciousness. historical_references.reference: Chinmayi is a popular Hindu name for girls, derived from the Sanskrit words 'chin' meaning consciousness and 'maya' meaning illusion. This name is believed to have been used as early as the 11th century in India, and its popularity continued through the medieval and modern periods. It is common among Hindus and Jains.

Another reference to the name Chinmayi comes from the 16th-century Indian epic, the Mahabharata, where Chinmayi is the name of a celestial musical instrument. This name is associated with the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and music.
